job.title: Sponsorship Sales Manager
job.description:
Sponsorship Sales Manager (Business Development) - Fintech Events | London

At a glance
•      Location: Central London, hybrid (3 days a week in the office)
•      Salary: £45K base + uncapped commission
•      Contract: Full-time, permanent
•      Experience: Proven B2B sponsorship or relationship-led b2b sales experience
•      Eligibility: UK-based with the right to work in the UK

I recently attended this client’s flagship event, and it was one of the best I’ve been to. They set the bar high. The venue, the atmosphere, the content, the networking, the friendly welcome from the team, and the excellent coffee and food all made the day feel special. It was busy but relaxed.

The networking area was one of the busiest I’ve seen at any conference, and you could tell the sponsors were happy. The sessions I attended were standing room only, with the audience completely engaged. The events team couldn’t have done more. They were warm and helpful, and guests clearly felt looked after. You can tell the team really care.

Now they’re taking one of their smaller, established fintech events and making it much bigger for next year, and they are recruiting an outstanding sales person to lead sponsorship sales on the conference.

The role
You’ll own the sales for this event. You’ll be selling to senior marketing and commercial decision makers at high profile companies, and you’ll have a real say in how the event develops.

A typical day might include
  • Researching and contacting companies you think should be involved, by phone, email and LinkedIn
  • Getting on calls with prospects to understand what they want from an event, such as leads, brand visibility or time with particular people
  • Writing proposals built around those goals, from sponsorship and hospitality to roundtables and private meetings
  • Following up, negotiating and closing deals
  • Getting back in touch with past clients and finding ways to do more with them
  • Working with the content, marketing and events teams so sponsors get what they paid for and rebook
  • Keeping your pipeline and forecasts updated in HubSpot
  • Heading out to industry events and client meetings to meet sponsors face to face

What you’ll need
  • A solid track record of winning new clients, building those relationships and growing the accounts over time
  • Ideally 2-4 years in sponsorship sales. If you’ve done similar relationship-led selling elsewhere, for example as a recruiter in financial services or tech, we’d still like to hear from you.
  • Knowledge of fintech, or the ability to learn it quickly enough to talk confidently with the people in it
  • Confidence speaking with senior decision makers
  • Excellent organisation and follow-up without needing to be chased
  • Ambition and a strong motivation to earn well

It’s a small team, so there’s no fighting over accounts, and there’s plenty of room to grow with them.

How to Apply
If you are an experienced b2b sales professional looking for your next step, I would love to hear from you. Please send your CV to helen@jbrecruitment.co.uk and I will be in touch for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Sponsorship Sales Executive - Tech and Digital Infrastructure Events
job.description:
Sponsorship Sales Executive - Tech and Digital Infrastructure Events
Central London Office + Travel
Salary up to £38,000 + Commission + Benefits

Sponsorship Sales Executive: Tech and Digital Infrastructure Events, London

Role at a glance

  • Job title: Sponsorship Sales Executive
  • Sector: B2B tech and digital infrastructure events (conferences and exhibitions)
  • Level: Graduate, with 12 to 18 months of B2B sales experience
  • Location: Central London Office + Travel
  • Salary: Up to £38,000 + uncapped commission
  • Events: One or two launch events per year across Europe and the USA, each attracting thousands of attendees
  • Recruiter: Jackson Barnes Recruitment, specialist B2B events recruiters

The opportunity

Our client is a well established global B2B events business with offices across four continents, and events running in more than 20 countries every year. Their events are large scale, each attracting thousands of senior attendees. Their tech and digital infrastructure brand is launching new events across Europe and the USA and they are looking to expand their sponsorship sales team to support this growth.
 
They are looking for an ambitious early career salesperson to join the team selling sponsorship and exhibition packages. You will focus on one, possibly two, launch events per year. This means you get to know your market inside out, build genuine relationships with your clients, and play a real part in shaping a brand new event from the ground up. 

Why a career in B2B events sponsorship sales?

  • You sell something people value. Sponsors come to events to meet their customers face to face, launch products and build their brand. You are selling real business outcomes.
  • You become a market expert. Within months you will understand the tech and digital infrastructure sector, its key players and its challenges, and clients will see you as a trusted partner.
  • You see the results of your work. There are very few sales roles where you can walk the event floor and see your clients’ stands, speakers and branding come to life.
  • Your earning potential is strong. Good sponsorship sellers are well rewarded, and the skills you build are highly sought after across the global events industry.
  • The career path is clear. Many of today’s commercial directors and MDs in B2B events started in exactly this kind of role.

What you will be doing

  • Sourcing new clients through a mix of inbound and outbound leads – email marketing, database, LinkedIn, competitor events and market research etc
  • Taking clients through the full sales process, from discovery and presentation through to closing
  • Writing tailored proposals that show clients how the event meets their business goals
  • Negotiating and closing deals
  • Meeting and exceeding your KPIs and revenue targets
  • Managing and keeping your sales pipeline up to date
  • Keeping the CRM accurate and using the latest technology to work more efficiently
  • Using LinkedIn to build your profile and promote the event to your market
  • Meeting clients both in person and on screen
  • Attending industry events and your own events onsite
  • Working closely with colleagues in production, marketing and event operations to share insight and make each event the best it can be
  • Taking part in structured long term sales training to develop your skills

What we are looking for

  • A graduate with around 12 to 18 months of B2B sales experience, ideally from recruitment, media sales or tech solutions sales
  • Someone who now wants to build a sales career within a B2B events business
  • Confidence in a B2B solutions led, consultative sales approach
  • Driven by targets, with a track record of meeting or exceeding KPIs
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Strong organisation and the ability to manage your own pipeline
  • Confidence using the latest technology and AI tools to improve your sales process
  • Comfortable meeting senior clients in person and over video
  • A team player with a strong work ethic
  • A proactive, positive, glass half full attitude
  • Likes the idea of taking on a project from its inception and being part of the growth story, leading on sales.

What our client offers

  • A trusted, long established brand in the tech and telecoms sector
  • Genuine international opportunity, with events and clients across Europe and the USA
  • Real ownership of launch events and the chance to build something from the start
  • A merit based culture where performance is recognised and rewarded
  • Structured sales training and a clear route to progression
  • Broad suite of benefits that support you throughout your career
 
Interested?
If you are ready to take the next step in your sales career and want to be part of an exciting launch portfolio, I would love to hear from you. Please send your CV to helen@jbrecruitment.co.uk for a confidential conversation.

What does a Senior Marketing Manager do in B2B events?

Our client is a well-respected B2B media and intelligence business, trusted by its professional community for credible, authoritative coverage of the sector it serves.
